card.name: Inside EXACERBATION in all-caps warnings
card.fires_on: The letter piece in the middle of an all-caps word, mostly the B in EXACERBATION in hepatitis B warning headings. It also fires on the V in AGGRAVATE.

modes.label: EXACERBATION in boxed warning
modes.description: The B inside EXACERBATION(S) in the all-caps heading about post-treatment hepatitis flares.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

modes.label: AGGRAVATE in caps
modes.description: The V inside the all-caps word AGGRAVATE.
modes.example: INE, WHICH MAY FURTHER AGGRA<<V>>ATE DEHYDRATION AND ELECTRO
